maddeler.e:
نلتحم (form VIII)
# نَلْتَحِمُ (naltaḥimu) /nal.ta.ħi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# نُلْتَحَمُ (nultaḥamu) /nul.ta.ħa.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# نَلْتَحِمَ (naltaḥima) /nal.ta.ħi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# نُلْتَحَمَ (nultaḥama) /nul.ta.ħa.ma/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
